summary: Operator site read live via headless browser (was 406 to curl). Confirmed 2026 $35 (tax incl.) 30/50 A full hookups, 2 adults + kids under 18, $5 extra adult; booking is a request form + deposit (phone -> operator); no tent sites any more. Site count 18 / pull-through / showers are not on the operator's pages (left as stored). Not waterfront, pin OK (~80 m from the loop).
flags: OHV (flag only, reviewer decides): the operator markets itself as 'Featherstone RV & ATV Park ... ATV Friendly Full Hookup RV, Tent, and ATV Camping on The Tuscobia State Trail' and says 'Campers usually ride out daily to various destinations! Everyone is welcome to ride along! Most rides are 5-6 hours'. That is a private park marketing ATV riding that starts at the campground (the brief's OHV-base pattern). It is also an ordinary full-hookup RV park with a posted nightly rate; Google reviews describe both ATV riders and a bear-hunting stay ('Stayed for 17 nights ... for bear hunting! ... they do have a shower house, and atv wash station (coin operated)', 3 years ago).
PRICE GATE passes: $35 tax included (2026). Google 4.6 over 35; RV Life 4.5 stored. Presence: working website with phone 715-354-3610 (= stored).

LONG-STAY: 'Please call about seasonal/yearly rates and availability' - nightly share not measurable (no site list or map on the site); the operator leads with the nightly rate and the reviews read are overnight/short stays. Not read as mostly seasonal.
UNSOURCED: stored sites.count 18 and pull_through (note-derived) appear nowhere on the operator's pages; facilities.showers is supported only by a Google review (left as stored).
Reviews: one 6-year-old Google review complains of overbearing owners ('We will not be back ... owners that are overbearing and over opinionated'); recent ones are positive. Cash or check only.
